evidence.quote: The MA treatment (Retsch PM-100, Haan, Germany) was performed at 400 rpm for 30 minutes followed by a 10-minute cool-down period and further re-spinning in opposite direction. The process was then repeated until reaching a total time of 8 hours.

The 8-h MA+SPS sample compacted at 800 °C showed high residual porosity reaching up to 7.61% (Tab. 2). The pores were irregular in shape, which corresponded to the free spaces between loose powder particles that were not sealed during SPS compaction.
The pores were uniformly distributed with a mostly circular geometry and sub-micrometre dimensions.
the as-cast alloy exhibited a rather average porosity of 0.64% when compared to that of the 8-h MA+SPS sample compacted at 1000 °C
The as-cast alloy showed the presence of areas that were enriched in certain elements while the content of the rest was lowered and vice versa (see Fig. 6a).
